text:
zoe_sales: Quick presales: Prospect 'Europay' wants a 10-day POC. Requirements: EU-only tenant, BYOK mandatory, keys must be bound to ireland (eu-west-1). They want a subprocessors CSV, a one-line KMS statement for their questionnaire, and a rough uplift for pinning. Can Dedicated handle strict key-region binding + frankfurt compute-only failover? cc @omar_platform @clara_security

 omar_platform: Yes, Dedicated or Private. Hosted can't guarantee region-locked BYOK. If keys are region-locked to eu-west-1, compute failover to eu-central-1 will only work if keys are replicated or an exception is granted. We can set failover to "blocked_if_key_unavailable" to avoid cross-region key use.

 clara_security: Short subprocessors list for procurement: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), GCP (europe-west3), Cloudflare (CDN), Fastly (edge), Datadog (metrics), Sentry (errors), HashiCorp Vault (KMS partner). One-line KMS statement: "Customer-managed keys supported on Dedicated/Private with HSM-backed BYOK; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default, Hosted-BYOK available under addendum and extra attestation."

 zoe_sales: They asked for a tiny routing policy snippet for their infra team and a p95 test script.

 omar_platform: Minimal routing policy example:

 {
  "tenant":"europay-poc",
  "routing":{"mode":"tenant_pin","primary":"eu-west-1","failover":["eu-central-1"],"failover_behavior":"blocked_if_key_unavailable"},
  "kms":{"mode":"byok_hsm","region_bind":"eu-west-1"}
 }

 omar_platform: Tiny p95 test (bash) to run from their Ireland office:

 for i in {1..120}; do
   start=$(date +%s%3N)
   curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' >/dev/null
   now=$(date +%s%3N)
   echo $((now-start))
 done | sort -n | awk 'NR==int(0.95*NR){print "p95:"$1}'

 clara_security: Pricing note: pinning requires reserved capacity -> expect a reservation fee + ~15-25% per-token uplift depending on sizing. Ops timeline: Dedicated tenant provisioning 5-8 business days after PO + capacity; BYOK import & HSM attestation +3-7 business days. Need from customer: expected peak rps, avg seq len, and whether they can replicate keys or accept a failover exception.

 ops_bot: Created ticket POC-7711; uploaded EU attestation pack and subprocessors CSV.

 zoe_sales: I'll collect peak rps and seq len and ask about key replication. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
